title: Engineers work weekdays
author: agam
hypothesis: Hacker News runs on the work week: a weekday carries well over 30% more activity than a weekend day.
expect: If true, average daily items on Mon-Fri should be at least 1.3x the average on Sat-Sun.
caveats: Weekdays are UTC. Someone posting Friday night in Asia counts as Friday.
Window is 11 weeks (Jul 22 - Oct 8 2026), so one holiday can move the result.
